mentions.name: NLHE Poker Trainer App
mentions.description: A no-limit hold'em (NLHE) poker trainer app with a web poker room for multiplayer play, bots, and fake chips. Built in Elixir and Phoenix using Event Sourcing with some CQRS; the player view is a projection of House Events that doubles as a hand history suitable for feeding to solvers or LLMs for real-time advice or post-hoc analysis. Aims to help players get many reps across varied situations with excellent advice to build good intuitions and decision-making, with plans to monetize while open sourcing the hand history format.
mentions.problem: Poker players need to get tons of reps in across varied situations with excellent advice to build good intuitions and decision-making abilities, stop making bad or terrible decisions, or just play poker for free.
mentions.audience: Poker players who want to get tons of reps across varied situations with excellent advice to build good intuitions and decision-making abilities, stop making bad or terrible decisions, or just play poker for free.
